claims.claim_text: Listed-equity financed emissions methodology is market_value_meur / issuer_evic_meur * issuer_revenue_meur, referencing PCAF Standard §B61 proxy, with revenue substituted for direct issuer emissions due to absence of counterparty-level emission data in investment records.
evidence_sources: draft_markdown: Methodology (listed equity)
